name: claude-orchestrator
description: Multi-agent orchestration harness for Codex and Claude Code: implement -> independent code-review -> independent security-review -> merge-on-green, with git-worktree isolation, helper scripts, and release/back-merge discipline.

interface.longDescription: Drive tickets through isolated implementation, independent review and security gates, optional verification, merge-on-green, release/back-merge, ticket scoping, and recovery workflows. Codex uses the natural-language skills and helper scripts; Claude Code can also use the slash commands and hook metadata bundled in this repository.
defaultPrompt: Orchestrate this ticket end to end
